bugs.title: Password reset token does not expire
bugs.description: Reset tokens issued by /password-recovery/{email} remain valid indefinitely. A leaked token from months ago can still reset the user's password. Should expire after ~1 hour.

bugs.title: Item delete authorizes non-owner when superuser flag is set client-side
bugs.description: DELETE /items/{id} appears to trust an is_superuser flag derived from the user record without re-checking ownership in some edge cases. A regular user crafting a request can sometimes delete items belonging to other users. Needs hardened ownership check.

bugs.title: Signup endpoint has no rate limiting
bugs.description: POST /users/signup accepts unlimited requests from the same IP, enabling enumeration of registered emails via the 400 duplicate-email response and trivial account-spam attacks.

bugs.title: Password recovery email renders raw HTML from user-supplied address
bugs.description: The recovery email template interpolates the supplied email address into the HTML body without escaping, allowing an HTML injection if an attacker registers an email like ''. The email is not delivered to the attacker but to the existing owner, who sees the injected markup.

bugs.title: Update-password endpoint accepts empty new_password
bugs.description: PATCH /users/me/password validates that current_password matches but does not enforce a minimum length on new_password, allowing a user to set their password to an empty string and lock themselves out.
